WHAT THE NULL ACTUALLY SAYS, because it is a result and not an absence: your
campaign moved no value on any of the thousand worlds. That is worth a
chronicle line if your campaign expected to move something — a null is
informative exactly when a prediction preceded it — and worth nothing at all if
you only ran it to be safe. You know which; I do not.

ONE THING WORTH KNOWING ABOUT THAT MESSAGE, since it is easy to misread as "the
run failed to do anything": the null arm reports honestly now. It used to
announce "Goldens delivered" on a run that moved nothing, because the timings
row always made the staged set non-empty and the arm that would have said
otherwise was unreachable for the life of the script. Two censuses on
2026-09-02 delivered branches whose entire content was one timings line while
claiming goldens. What you are reading is the corrected form: it names the
branch as carrying the timings row only, and says plainly there is nothing to
merge for goldens' sake.

Your two stages tonight were green at 1432 s and 1414 s, a third is queued, and
this census is a clean null. Nothing on your candidate concerns me.
